and documented business requirements, user stories,functional specifications and acceptance criteria for institutionalcustody account onboarding.•Produced L3/L4 process models, business process maps, businessrequirements aligned across Operations, Product and Technologyteams.•Developed benefit realisation models by validating FTE savings,preparing supporting business cases and securing processing.•Designed automation for the automatic placement of No-DebitHolds on eligible accounts based on customer contribution rules.•Defined business rules to automatically generate disbursalinstructions for clearing arrears and uncleared funds on home loanaccounts.•Delivered requirements for credit score and usability matrix-drivenhome loan limit reduction, enabling automated risk-based limit•CONTACT
